"''Ok!|Landonis Calrissian and Kalo'ne|''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''}} '''Kalo'ne''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[Yokaa]] who resided on the [[planet]] [[Pasaana]], driving a [[DN-25 treadable]] that she used to transport passengers and goods. She had worked on the [[planet]] for several [[Standard decade|decades]], witnessing many occurrences of the [[Festival of the Ancestors]]. In [[35 ABY]], she gave passage to the hermit [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Landonis Calrissian]] and [[Resistance]] members [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], [[Finn]], [[Poe Dameron]], and [[Chewbacca]], who were visiting Pasaana on a [[Mission to Pasaana (Resistance)|mission]] to search for the [[Sith]] [[assassin]] [[Ochi]]. Calrissian asked Kalo'ne to take them to the [[east passage]], where she successfully delivered the group. ==Biography== Kalo'ne was a [[Gender|female]] [[Yokaa]] [[DN-25 treadable]] driver who worked on the [[planet]] [[Pasaana]], transporting goods and passengers. She traveled a circuit of stops on the world and would keep the cabin of her vehicle filled with a variety of wares from the locales she visited. Passengers were encouraged to browse the wares during their journey, although no prices were listed and everything was negotiable. Each journey seemed to last just long enough for her to make a profitable sale. [[File:Kalone-Treadable-TROS.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kalo'ne in her DN-25 treadable.]] By [[35 ABY]],{{FilmDate|IX|Kalo'ne's appearance}} Kalo'ne had been working in her treadable for [[Standard decade|decades]] and had weathered many [[Festival of the Ancestors|Festivals of the Ancestors]], even joking to new visitors that she was one of the ancestors being honored. The festival was always a busy [[time]] for her as the treadable was in high demand for transit duty, with riders often bartering goods for transport that Kalo'ne could then sell to other passengers for profit. In that [[Standard year|year]], one of the customers that hired out Kalo'ne's vehicle was the hermit [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], who rushed on board with [[Resistance]] agents [[Poe Dameron]], [[Finn]], [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], [[C-3PO]], [[BB-8]] and [[Chewbacca]] in order to avoid [[First Order]] [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] at the festival. Calrissian requested that she drive to the [[east passage]] through the sliding slot in her door, which she agreed to before closing the slot. At the end of the journey, the Resistance agents dismounted, leaving Calrissian on board with Kalo'ne while they continued their [[Mission to Pasaana (Resistance)|search]] for the [[Sith]] [[assassin]] [[Ochi]].{{Film|IX}} ==Personality and traits== Kalo'ne was flinty and age-worn after decades of treadable driving and was most comfortable in her driving cabin with her [[Snake|serpentine]] body wrapped around the steering column. She spoke with customers through the slot in her door or using a decrepit loudspeaker system. She had three [[Color|blue]] tri-lensed [[eye]]s with multi-spectral vision. Her skin was gray and her [[hair]] was pink. ==Equipment== Kalo'ne wore a red [[Clothing|robe]] and drove a DN-25 treadable. During the Festival of Ancestors in 35 ABY she was carrying cargo including hoary [[digwort]] fronds, at least two sacks of [[flint-rind fig]]s and a [[reed-twine]] wrapped bundle of tarp. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Wizard_44.png|thumb|right|200px|Wizard 44 by Louis Wiltshire]] Kalo'ne was created for the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. Concept art of Kalo'ne titled "Wizard 44" was drawn by creature concept designer and senior sculptor [[Louis Wiltshire]].''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]'' Kalo'ne was performed by creature performer [[Dave Chapman]].{{Facebook|username=cotnoir|url=cotnoir/posts/10160853087724446?comment_id=183671231300015|name=Patrick Cotnoir|date=2023-05-23|quote=That Muppet is me.|archivefile=File:DaveChapman-Kalone-Facebook-2023-05-24.png}} ==Appearances== *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Kalo'ne}} *''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]'' *''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]'' *{{InsiderCite|202|The Eyes Have It}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'', second edition]] *{{Databank|kalo-ne|Kalo'ne}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Kalo'ne |fr=Kalo'ne |ja=カロネ |ka=კალო'ნი }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Yokaa]]
